title: Correct spring constant
description: Essential: Student calculates k = ΔF/Δx correctly, obtaining approximately 41.67 N/m.

title: Correct final length
description: Essential: Student calculates L = L₀ + Δx correctly, obtaining 32 cm.

title: Applies Hooke's Law
description: Important: Student uses Hooke's Law (F = kΔx) to relate force and elongation.

title: Calculates elongation for 5.00N
description: Important: Student correctly computes Δx₁ = F₁/k for the 5.00N weight.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student converts cm to m appropriately or maintains consistent units throughout.

title: Confuses length with elongation
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses L₀ directly in Hooke's Law or fails to add L₀ to Δx.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall: Student forgets to convert cm to m, leading to incorrect k (e.g., 0.4167 N/cm).
